[[Black dragon|Black dragons]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]] at level 80 [[combat]] by various [[Slayer master]]s (or at any combat level by [[Krystilia]]) after partial completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]].

Black dragons are the rarest of [[chromatic dragons]]. As with all other chromatic dragons, they use melee and short-ranged [[dragonfire]]. When killing the standard variant of Black dragons, its recommended to use [[Protect from Melee]] and basic dragonfire protection (such as an [[anti-dragon shield]] and [[extended antifire]] potion), as the dragons are quite accurate and hit relatively hard.

Players can additionally kill [[baby black dragon]]s, [[brutal black dragon]]s, or the [[King Black Dragon]] as alternatives for a black dragon task.

While most variants of black dragons can be very profitable to kill, optimal strategies involve either quickly killing baby black dragons (as they are easily accessible in [[Taverley Dungeon]] with the task-only area) or [[brutal black dragon]]s (which require 77 [[Slayer]]).

==== Brutal Black Dragons ====
If deciding to kill [[Brutal black dragon]]s for the generous drops, be aware that they have additional attack types to consider. Brutal black dragons have long-ranged dragonfire and a ranged magical attack that will deal high amounts of damage. An effective strategy for killing them involves bringing your strongest crossbow and using [[Protect from Magic]] while standing out of melee range. Standing north of the vine to Lovakengj is a safe way to do this. While the [[Dragon hunter crossbow]] is the most effective, much more affordable options like the [[Hunters' sunlight crossbow]], [[Dragon crossbow]], or even [[Rune crossbow]] can be sufficient.

Faster methods involve using the [[Dragon hunter lance]] or other melee. With melee methods, keep [[Protect from Magic]] on at all times and use a [[flinching]] strategy to avoid the dragon's accurate melee attacks.

==== Other Notes ====
If killing baby dragons, go to [[Taverley Dungeon]] and utilise the task-only area; there are five spawns (in a group of two and three respectively) which can be AFK'ed to quickly complete the task.

If killing normal dragons, the ones in the [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]] are the closest to a bank, with a quick [[Mythical cape]] teleport to go back and forth.

Players who have started the [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze|Freeing Sir Amik Varze]] sub quest in Recipe for Disaster can also sacrifice a [[raw chicken]] at the [[Chicken Shrine]] in [[Zanaris]] to access the [[Evil Chicken's Lair|Evil Chicken’s lair]], home to several black dragons and in close proximity to the Zanaris bank.

In the Wilderness, the player only has two options to choose from; the [[Lava Maze Dungeon]] and the [[Wilderness Slayer Cave]]. The former is significantly troublesome to access without 82 [[Agility]] (boostable), as this would require the player to traverse the entire [[Lava Maze]] and bring a [[knife]] to cut webs. The latter is far more accessible, but the dragons are slightly stronger and the cave itself is both a [[multicombat area]] and a popular [[player killing]] spot. In the slayer cave, players are still able to teleport out with a one-click teleport such as a [[royal seed pod]], though they must be safespotted.

If killing the King Black Dragon, players should not bring any items they are unwilling to lose. While the trek from the level 44 [[Wilderness Obelisk]] to the King Black Dragon's lair is very short, it is a popular player killing spot and escape is likely impossible if attacked by a player killer.
